verdict.rationale: Bevy is explicitly MIT OR Apache-2.0 licensed (confirmed both in docs and via crates.io metadata), with first-party messaging explicitly stating no contracts, no license fees, no sales cuts, forever free — directly matching the studio-lead's no-royalty, keep-your-earnings requirement. Community sentiment corroborates this as a genuine differentiator versus proprietary engines. Missing for 10: no independent legal/commercial analysis of dual-licensing implications for studios beyond community praise.
